scope: Country Panel, country/fund/VL/SGO operational routes and immediately adjacent FX write path. Static/read-only audit only; no mutation route invoked.
existing_auth_authority: src/middleware/auth.js exports authenticate/authorize/optionalAuth. Reuse it; do not build a second auth system.

classification_rules.PUBLIC_REFERENCE: Read-only reference/discovery data intended for public product pages may remain unauthenticated after privacy review.
classification_rules.AUTHENTICATED_READ: Back-office operational data should require a valid user session even if it does not mutate.
classification_rules.AUTHORIZED_MUTATION: Any fund/SGO/VL/user/fee write requires authentication plus role/ownership authorization.
classification_rules.GOVERNED_MUTATION: Financial/data corrections or bulk imports also require dry-run/preview, snapshot/transaction/rollback/post-check appropriate to risk.
classification_rules.REMOVE_OR_DEPRECATE: Legacy HTTP writers superseded by scheduled governed pipelines should not remain public write endpoints.

current_findings.current_effect: Fetches third-party FX data and bulk-inserts into devisedechanges despite HTTP GET semantics.
current_findings.secret_issue: Contains an inline third-party credential; value intentionally omitted.
remediation: Treat provider credential as exposed and rotate/revoke externally.
Prove scheduled scripts/import/scrape_forex_import.js is canonical runtime path.
Disable/deprecate public GET-with-write route after consumer audit.
If an operator-triggered refresh remains needed, expose an authenticated/authorized POST or workflow with dry-run/evidence, using secret authority.

current_findings.current_effect: Updates SGO metadata and can change password of a linked user when password is supplied.
remediation: Require authenticate.
Require admin or proven owning management-company role; exact role/ownership semantics must be verified from live auth/JWT conventions.
Split ordinary SGO profile update from password change or require a dedicated password-reset/re-auth contract.
Add tests proving cross-SGO modification is denied.

current_findings.current_effect: Directly updates canonical VL and derived EUR/USD values, then emits recalculation.
current_findings.code_integrity_issue: The previousValues loop references exchangeRatesEUR/exchangeRatesUSD that are scoped inside the prior loop, so non-empty previousValues can fail after partial updates.
remediation: Do not merely add auth; first fix transactional integrity and variable-scope defect with RED tests.
Require authenticate + admin/authorized country/manager ownership.
Validate requested fund belongs to caller's authorized scope.
Preview exact row/date/value changes before apply.
Use transaction and rollback/snapshot; avoid partial write on failure.
Recalculate derived values only after canonical write commits.
Record correction reason/evidence/batch.

current_findings.current_effect: Bulk inserts/updates canonical VL from uploaded CSV and recomputes adjusted values.
remediation: Require authenticate + ownership/role authorization.
Replace direct apply-first behavior with parse/validate/dry-run preview then explicit apply.
Validate fund identity, currency, date, price semantics and source provenance.
Use bounded transaction/snapshot/rollback.
Preserve current URL only as compatibility wrapper if frontend consumers require it.

current_findings.current_effect: Creates a canonical fund row with identity/classification/manager/payment-related fields.
remediation: Require authenticate + admin/authorized country/manager role.
Validate country/manager ownership and canonical identity rules.
Do not allow client-provided category/region text to become canonical without reference mapping.
Never require/fabricate ISIN where market source does not publish one.
Require authenticate + role/ownership.
Restrict editable field set; do not mass-assign identity/security-sensitive fields.
Log old/new values for material fund-reference changes.

current_findings.current_effect: Writes valuation/index data or propagates index-related changes.
remediation: Require auth/role/ownership.
Use strict temporal rule exact-or-prior, never future.
Preview and transaction for financial/index data changes.
Unify with W1 benchmark/FX temporal contracts rather than creating parallel semantics.
Require authenticate + authorize('admin') or exact existing admin authority.
Add negative tests for unauthenticated/non-admin users.
Keep endpoint response shape compatible where frontend depends on it.

current_findings.current_effect: Returns operational/back-office data; some fund-list routes accept arbitrary pays query parameter.
remediation: Admin/user-account lists must require admin auth.
Country/manager operational fund lists should enforce ownership if used by Country Panel.
If a country fund list is intended public, expose a separate public read model rather than overloading an operational endpoint with arbitrary pays.
May remain public if no sensitive fields are returned.
Prefer stable read-only reference/view models and rate limiting.
Do not couple public reference reads to operator mutations.

current_findings.current_auth: Frontend calls this path but no current API implementation was found.
current_findings.current_effect: Country Panel import workflow is not backed by a certified current API contract.
remediation: Do not map blindly to /api/uploadsfilevl/:id because semantics differ.
Define import dry-run contract: source/artifact, country, mapping, would_insert/update/reject, quality/provenance.
Require explicit apply phase with auth/ownership and evidence.
Preserve Country Panel UX route while swapping underlying client/API incrementally.

frontend_migration_constraints: Many Country Panel pages use direct fetch without Authorization. Adding authenticate server-side before updating the frontend/session transport would cause immediate regressions.
Use existing src/lib/api.ts or an additive shared authenticated server/client helper; do not rewrite all screens at once.
Characterize whether calls execute server-side or client-side before choosing token transport.
For each protected route, add a compatibility test matrix: unauthenticated=401, wrong-role/cross-country=403, authorized=200/expected response.
Keep public product routes distinct from operational back-office routes.
explicit_non_actions: No POST/PUT/DELETE/GET-with-side-effect route was invoked during this audit.
No authentication middleware was added yet.
next_action: Promote a bounded Country Operations Security task only after AF-TASK-028 releases queue ownership. First implementation phase must be tests/client-auth plumbing; do not start by blanket-protecting every legacy route.
